value.title: Christmas Eve
value.synopsis: As their first Christmas Eve together approaches, Suzuki and Tani plan their date. They decide to challenge themselves to make a cake, and Suzuki's heart flutters as she watches how seriously Tani takes everything, and then...

value.title: Dilemma of a Winter`s Night
value.synopsis: In the middle of winter break, Yamada grows anxious about the fact that his relationship with Nishi just hasn't made much progress. He uses homework as a pretext to see her, but he can't find the right timing to confess his feelings.

value.title: The Year That`s Passed, and the Year to Come
value.synopsis: Tani tells his family that he's dating someone, and asks Suzuki over on New Year's Day. Flustered by the invitation, Suzuki makes one gaffe after another in front of his family. On the last day of winter break, the usual group of friends enjoy visiting a shrine together. Moved by Tani's words about living with no regrets, each of them step into the new year with hopes and feelings in their hearts.

value.title: New School Term
value.synopsis: The new term begins. Taira realizes that he has been under a misconception for years. Suzuki takes Yamada to the school library, with an ulterior motive in mind. Nishi is happy that Yamada came, but anxious that others might find out about their relationship. When Honda asks what that relationship is, Nishi feels absolutely overwhelmed, but with a little nudge, Nishi realizes her true feelings.

value.title: Valentine`s Day
value.synopsis: Yamada still hasn't found the right timing to confess to Nishi, but the day of their date arrives nonetheless.

value.title: Threshold of Spring
value.synopsis: As the school year draws to a close, Azuma realizes that she doesn't want to lose her connection to Taira.

value.title: Gradation
value.synopsis: During spring break, Yamada and Nishi spend some quality time together at the aquarium that brings them even closer. Suzuki’s birthday arrives, and on a date with Tani, she expresses her anxiety about things to come. Tani's words set her at ease, but in truth, he also feels anxious. For the new term, Azuma and Taira end up in different classes. Azuma tells herself that they’re just friends, but…

value.title: The Future
value.synopsis: Nishi and Yamada spend some time at Yamada's house.

value.title: Past and Present
value.synopsis: Azuma realizes she has feelings for Taira, and Tani seems down about graduating.

value.title: Feelings and Choices
value.synopsis: Suzuki and Tani study together to prepare for their upcoming exams.

value.title: Somewhere to Belong
value.synopsis: Azuma realizes she has feelings for Taira but keeps her distance to avoid ruining their relationship.

value.title: Starting Line
value.synopsis: Azuma realizes she won't see Taira as often after graduation and tries to say goodbye without regrets.

value.title: You and I Are Polar Opposites
value.synopsis: Under a blue sky, Suzuki holds back her tears as she watches Tani board the train.
